headline: Jalen Ramsey says he has a broken wrist
summary: In advance of Thursday night's game at Cleveland, Steelers defensive back Jalen Ramsey was listed as limited in practice on Monday and Tuesday, with a wrist injury.

headline: Jalen Hurts: I felt fine during concussion check, wish they could have expedited things
summary: Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts had to leave the game for a concussion evaluation after getting hit on the sideline during Monday night's loss to the Bears, and that proved costly for the Eagles: They were in the red zone at the time, but they came away with no points when backup quarterback Andy Dalton threw an interception.

headline: Titans place OLs Fernando Carmona, Jackson Slater on injured reserve
summary: The Titans have made a few roster moves on Tuesday.

headline: Ravens-Cowboys in Brazil averaged record 29.9M viewers
summary: The Ravens' 34-31 victory over the Cowboys in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, averaged 29.9 million viewers on CBS on Sunday, making it the most-watched NFL international game in history.

headline: Cowboys' Schottenheimer 'aligned' with Jones after Rio gaffes
summary: Cowboys coach Brian Schottenheimer said he would "be better" after meeting with Jerry Jones about questionable late-game coaching decisions in Sunday's loss to the Ravens.

headline: Brian Schottenheimer: I hurt the team in loss to the Ravens
summary: Cowboys owner Jerry Jones said there was "no explanation" for how the team closed out the game.
